description: Faz 8-P2 P2-0B characterization corpus — V1 (compute_raw_from_delta + provenanced_from_raw) vs V2-candidate (measure_task_delta) semantic divergence measurement. Case content is produced by Rust builders (crates/osp-core/tests/common/faz8_p2_cases.rs); this manifest pins each case's serialized-bytes BLAKE3 digest so builder drift is DETECTED (explicit fixture+digest update required). Corpus change is detected by digest verification, not prevented.

divergence_classes.matching_scope: task.predicate.scope and proposal.affected_nodes describe the same node set — subject/value parity but INV-T4 source divergence (V1 Scip override vs V2 TreeSitter axis)
divergence_classes.wide_affected_scope: proposal.affected_nodes is a strict superset of task.predicate.scope — known production-reachable divergence (V1 measures wider centroid)
divergence_classes.removed_edge_external_source: removed_edges[*].from references a node outside task.predicate.scope — divergence (V1 folds into affected set)
divergence_classes.delta_introduced_subject: task.predicate.scope members are all introduced by the delta — V2 baseline UnavailableAllIntroduced (typed), V1 DefaultFallback (empty positions → RawPosition::default)
divergence_classes.mixed_per_axis_sources: subject members report different MetricSource per axis — V2 per-axis provenance (Mixed possible) vs V1 uniform Scip
